_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY — placeholders, never real people.
Copy to pilot-household.local.json (git-ignored) and fill in the real
pilot household there. Never commit the filled file, and never copy its
contents into a migration, into supabase/seed.sql, into a committed test
fixture, into documentation, or into a source-code constant (ADR-034).
NO PASSWORD LIVES HERE. The pilot password comes from the server-only
environment variable TORI_PILOT_PASSWORD and is never written to this file.
Ages are product context only: there is deliberately no dateOfBirth and no
age field. Do not add one without an approved, privacy-safe design.
The `id` values are stable UUIDs. Bootstrap upserts on them, which is what
makes repeated runs converge instead of duplicating.

adultPilotIdentity._comment: The single authenticated adult for the pilot. Password comes from TORI_PILOT_PASSWORD.
